description: Moves the selection of an open Thunderbird menu or popup with letter keys, in every window. A key press under an open menu is turned into an ArrowDown or ArrowUp sent at once to the open popup.

functions.name: install
functions.description: Installs the key table, or replaces the one installed. The first call starts the window listener, which hooks every chrome window including dialogs, and later calls add none.

keys.description: The keys that move the selection: the typed character of each (`j`) and the way it moves.
